content.text:
**Analyzing Color Transformations**

I've been observing how the 2x2 red squares (color 2) behave when placed in different grid positions. It appears two of them consistently shift to teal (color 8) in the output, while one retains its original red hue. I'm exploring the positional logic behind this selective change.
